WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_id, p.flowhrs, p.proccpu, p.procgpu,
         (p.flowhrs * (p.proccpu + p.procgpu) / 2.0) / (s.gbsize * 10 * log10(m.facetverts + 10000.0)) AS pru
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanprocessing p ON p.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh m ON m.equipref = p.equipref AND m.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
), agg AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, AVG(pru) AS pru_raw, AVG(flowhrs) AS avg_hours, AVG(proccpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(procgpu) AS avg_gpu
  FROM base GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT equipment_id,
       ROUND(pru_raw, 2) AS pru_value,
       ROUND(avg_hours, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru_raw ASC) AS efficiency_ranking,
       CASE WHEN pru_raw IS NULL THEN 'No Data'
            WHEN pru_raw < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
            WHEN pru_raw <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
            ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
       json_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hours, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM agg
ORDER BY pru_raw ASC;

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       si.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(100 - 2.5 * abs(e.ambictemp - 20) - pow(abs((e.humepct - 50) / 2.0), 1.5) - 600.0 / (e.illumelux + 100)), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites si
JOIN scanenvironment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC;

WITH session_metrics AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref AS zone,
         pc.scanresolmm AS scanresolmm,
         pc.noisedb AS noisedb,
         r.errvalmm AS errvalmm,
         pc.coverpct * (1 + pc.lappct / 100.0 * (1 - pc.coverpct / 100.0)) AS sce,
         pow(10.0 / ((log10(pc.scanresolmm * 1000.0) / log10(pc.pointdense)) * 5.0), 1.5)
           * (pc.coverpct * (1 + pc.lappct / 100.0 * (1 - pc.coverpct / 100.0)) / 100.0)
           * pow(1 - pc.noisedb / 30.0, 2) AS sqs,
         pc.scanresolmm / (r.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + r.errvalmm / r.logaccumm)) AS rar
  FROM scans s
  JOIN scanpointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN scanregistration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref
), mesh_metrics AS (
  SELECT zoneref AS zone,
         ((facetfaces * 1.0 / (facetverts * facetresmm * facetresmm)) * 1000.0)
           * (((texpix * 1.0 / (sqrt(facetfaces) * facetresmm)) * 0.01) / 10.0)
           * (1 + exp(-geomdeltamm)) AS mfs
  FROM scanmesh
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       si.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(0.3 * ((x.sqs * 0.4) + (m.mfs * 0.4) + (x.sce * 0.2) - 5 * sqrt(x.noisedb / 10.0))
                 + 0.3 * m.mfs
                 + 0.2 * x.rar
                 + 0.2 * x.sce
                 - 2 * sqrt(x.errvalmm / x.scanresolmm)), 2) AS dpq
FROM sites si
JOIN session_metrics x ON x.zone = si.zoneregistry
JOIN mesh_metrics m ON m.zone = si.zoneregistry
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY dpq DESC;

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       si.zonelabel AS site_name,
       c.structstate AS structural_state,
       si.presstat AS preservation_status,
       CASE WHEN (si.presstat LIKE '%Poor%' OR si.presstat LIKE '%Critical%')
                  AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
            THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites si
JOIN scanconservation c ON c.zoneref = si.zoneregistry;

SELECT r.logregistry AS registration_id,
       r.arcref AS project_id,
       r.logaccumm AS registration_accuracy_mm,
       r.errvalmm AS error_value_mm,
       ROUND(pc.scanresolmm / (r.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + r.errvalmm / r.logaccumm)), 2) AS rar,
       CASE WHEN pc.scanresolmm / (r.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + r.errvalmm / r.logaccumm)) > 1.5
                  AND r.logmethod LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
            WHEN pc.scanresolmm / (r.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + r.errvalmm / r.logaccumm)) >= 1.0
                  AND pc.scanresolmm / (r.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + r.errvalmm / r.logaccumm)) <= 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
            ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS registration_confidence_level
FROM scanregistration r
JOIN scanpointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = r.arcref AND pc.crewref = r.crewref;

WITH workflow AS (
  SELECT p.flowsoft AS flowsoft, p.flowstage AS flowstage,
         p.flowhrs AS flowhrs, p.proccpu AS proccpu, p.procgpu AS procgpu, s.gbsize AS gbsize,
         (s.gbsize * log10(pc.totalpts)) / (p.flowhrs * (p.proccpu + p.procgpu) / 200.0) AS per
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
  JOIN scanpointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
)
SELECT flowsoft AS processing_software,
       flowstage AS processing_stage,
       ROUND(AVG(flowhrs), 1) AS avg_processing_hours,
       ROUND(AVG(proccpu), 0) AS avg_cpu_usage,
       ROUND(AVG(procgpu), 0) AS avg_gpu_usage,
       ROUND(AVG(gbsize), 1) AS avg_data_size_gb,
       ROUND(AVG(per), 1) AS avg_per,
       CASE WHEN AVG(per) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
       COUNT(*) AS workflow_count
FROM workflow
GROUP BY flowsoft, flowstage
ORDER BY efficiency_status ASC, avg_per ASC;

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       si.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(pow(10.0 / ((log10(pc.scanresolmm * 1000.0) / log10(pc.pointdense)) * 5.0), 1.5)
                 * ((pc.coverpct * (1 + pc.lappct / 100.0 * (1 - pc.coverpct / 100.0))) / 100.0)
                 * pow(1 - pc.noisedb / 30.0, 2)), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM sites si
JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
JOIN scanpointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC;

WITH site_env AS (
  SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
         si.zonelabel AS site_name,
         AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
         AVG(e.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
         AVG(e.illumelux) AS avg_illumination,
         AVG(100 - 2.5 * abs(e.ambictemp - 20) - pow(abs((e.humepct - 50) / 2.0), 1.5) - 600.0 / (e.illumelux + 100)) AS avg_esi
  FROM sites si
  JOIN scanenvironment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
)
SELECT site_code,
       site_name,
       ROUND(avg_temperature, 1) AS avg_temperature,
       ROUND(avg_humidity, 1) AS avg_humidity,
       ROUND(avg_illumination, 1) AS avg_illumination,
       ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
       CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_classification
FROM site_env;

WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
         pc.totalpts * 1.0 / (pc.clouddense * sp.aream2) AS pcdr,
         (f.traitcount + f.articount) * 1.0
           / ((pc.totalpts * 1.0 / (pc.clouddense * sp.aream2)) * sqrt(pc.clouddense)) * 1000.0 AS fee
  FROM sites si
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN scanspatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN scanfeatures f ON f.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
)
SELECT site_code,
       ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr,
       ROUND(AVG(fee), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM metrics
GROUP BY site_code
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC;

WITH mesh AS (
  SELECT facetregistry, zoneref, facetresmm, geomdeltamm,
         (facetfaces * 1.0 / (facetverts * facetresmm * facetresmm)) * 1000.0 AS mcr
  FROM scanmesh
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       si.zonelabel AS site_name,
       COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.facetresmm < 1.0 AND m.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN COUNT(m.facetregistry) = 0 THEN 0
                  ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.facetresmm < 1.0 AND m.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.facetregistry) END, 2) AS high_fidelity_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(m.mcr), 2) AS avg_mcr,
       ROUND(AVG(m.facetresmm), 2) AS avg_facetresmm,
       ROUND(AVG(m.geomdeltamm), 2) AS avg_geomdeltamm,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(m.facetregistry) = 0 THEN 'No Mesh Data'
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.facetresmm < 1.0 AND m.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
            ELSE 'Standard Mesh Quality' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM sites si
LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY high_fidelity_pct DESC;
